metadata.question: Was the soil in Washington more moist on November 22, 2021 than November 15, 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: SMAP soil moisture data (or Sentinel-1 backscatter as proxy) - Dates: November 22, 2021 vs November 15, 2021 - Location: Washington state (geometry polygon or bounding box) - Need to compare mean soil moisture between these two dates 2. Masking strategy: - SMAP data is radar-based, less affected by clouds - Use quality flags to filter bad pixels - No cloud masking needed, but filter by data quality 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null: - Valid result: numeric soil moisture value (0-100%) - Invalid: None/NaN or out-of-range values - Check pixel counts to ensure we have valid data - If either date has 0 valid pixels, output C2 - If collection is empty for a date, output C1 - Compare: if 2021-11-22 > 2021-11-15, answer A; else B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Washington state geometry const washington = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[ [-124.8, 49.0], [-116.9, 49.0], [-116.9, 45.6], [-124.8, 45.6], [-124.8, 49.0] ]]); // Get SMAP soil moisture data const smap = ee.ImageCollection('NASA_USDA/HSL/SMAP10KM_soil_moisture'); // Date 1: November 15, 2021 const col1 = smap .filterDate('2021-11-14', '2021-11-16') .filterBounds(washington) .select('ssm'); // soil surface moisture const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); if (size1 === 0) { console.log('Nov 15 Images: 0'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Date 2: November 22, 2021 const col2 = smap .filterDate('2021-11-21', '2021-11-23') .filterBounds(washington) .select('ssm'); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); if (size2 === 0) { console.log('Nov 22 Images: 0'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Get mean images const img1 = col1.mean(); const img2 = col2.mean(); // Calculate mean soil moisture for Nov 15 const stats1 = img1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: washington, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const moisture1 = stats1.get('ssm').getInfo(); // Calculate pixel count for Nov 15 const count1 = img1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: washington, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('ssm').getInfo(); // Calculate mean soil moisture for Nov 22 const stats2 = img2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: washington, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const moisture2 = stats2.get('ssm').getInfo(); // Calculate pixel count for Nov 22 const count2 = img2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: washington, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('ssm').getInfo(); // Validation if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log(`Nov 15 Pixels: ${count1}, Nov 22 Pixels: ${count2}`); console.log('C2'); return; } if (moisture1 === null || moisture2 === null || isNaN(moisture1) || isNaN(moisture2)) { console.log('Calculation resulted in NaN or null'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Output results console.log(`Nov 15, 2021: ${moisture1.toFixed(2)}% (Pixels: ${count1})`); console.log(`Nov 22, 2021: ${moisture2.toFixed(2)}% (Pixels: ${count2})`); // Determine answer if (moisture2 > moisture1) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
